description: Use when you need to know if a URL is up right now (uptime ping, health check, link check): one HEAD request from a Cloudflare edge (GET if HEAD answers 4xx/5xx), redirects followed up to 4. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /v1/uptime/ping, $0.01 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge.

url.description: public http or https URL to check, e.g. https://example.com/ (ports 80, 443, 8080, 8443)

name: url_uptime_ping
title: URL uptime ping
